subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – webinar email and currency
body_text:
Hi Tara,

Thank you for your time on the call. Your webinar registration page was not sending the confirmation email, and your products page was showing the wrong currency. Here is a quick summary so you have everything in one place.

What we resolved:
- We turned on the confirmation email for your webinar page and saved it, and after you registered with another email you confirmed the confirmation email arrived.
- Following our guidance, you selected Indian Rupee in Settings, Regional and saved it, and you confirmed your products page now looks right.

What we covered:
- The currency is set in your account's regional settings, and only the account owner can change it.

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-12

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Sameer
FlexiFunnels Support
